name: QuickChef golden dataset
description: Curated dish resolution, recipe, cart, flow, photo and edge cases for QuickChef.

modes.offline: Deterministic; LLM disabled, no network. Safe for CI.
modes.live: Needs GROQ_API_KEY for dish/recipe/flow cases and network access for photo cases.

gates.offline: Every offline case must pass; mean score 1.0.
gates.live: Every live case must pass; run nightly or before a release.

notes: Matar Kulcha is the key colloquial case: the canonical dish stays Matar Kulcha and the card must offer Chole Kulche, rather than silently mapping.
Offline modifier flows document the known limitation: the fallback recipe cannot honour exclusions, so the API returns a notice.
Photo cases check metadata and cache behaviour, not visual identity. A wrong photo is still a manual-review risk.
Baselines live in evals/baselines and are written with --write-baseline.
